key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:021C
name: select_and_link_top_entries
description: Library code that repeatedly scans a table of fixed-size records and picks the one with the highest comparison score. Records of one type are linked onto a list while the others have a flag cleared, and the routine returns a pointer into the last record it linked.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0224
name: register_font_entries_with_library
description: Library code that picks the highest-scoring record from a table on each pass and links selected records onto a list. It uses the dos library's directory and segment-loading stubs, exec's Permit and AddTail calls and the graphics library's AddFont call, then returns a pointer into the last linked record.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0304
name: unload_selected_font_segments
description: Library code that repeatedly selects the highest-scoring record from a table and passes a segment to the dos library's UnLoadSeg call. Matching records are linked onto a list, and the routine returns a pointer into the last linked record once no candidates remain.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:7:0322
name: close_and_free_font_entries
description: Library code that repeatedly picks the highest-scoring record from a table and releases resources with the dos library's Close, UnLock and CurrentDir calls, exec's FreeMem and the graphics library's CloseFont. It links records of one type onto a list and returns a pointer into the last one linked.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:0000
name: build_font_table_from_path
description: Library code that copies a name, and when the name ends with the font suffix it cuts that suffix off. It then examines the directory and allocates a table with one fixed-size record per matching file entry, returning the table or nothing if a step fails.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:00BA
name: load_disk_font_table
description: Library code that counts the entries in a directory source and allocates a table sized for them. It then copies each file entry's name, a word and two bytes from its record into the table, updating the stored count as it goes, and returns the table once the source is exhausted.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:0240
name: free_sized_memory_block
description: Library code that reads the size stored four bytes before a given pointer and releases that memory block through the exec library's FreeMem call. It returns nothing.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0000
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Library code that copies bytes from a source string into a destination buffer, including the terminating zero byte. It stops once the zero byte has been copied.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0010
name: seek_string_end_then_call
description: Library code that advances a pointer to the zero byte ending a string, then passes that position and the second argument to another routine. It does no other work.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:001A
name: seek_string_end_then_dispatch
description: Library code that advances a pointer to the zero byte ending a string, then passes that position to a library function called through a base pointer. It does no other work.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:002C
name: measure_string_length
description: Library code that counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string, not including the terminator, and returns the count.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0034
name: count_bytes_including_terminator
description: Library code that walks forward from a pointer, adding one to a count for each byte read until it reads a zero byte. The count starts from the value passed in the data register, and the routine returns the total.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:003C
name: compare_strings_standard_order
description: Library code that compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns -1 when the first differing byte of the first string is smaller, 1 when it is larger, and 0 when the strings are identical.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0046
name: compare_strings_reversed_order
description: Library code that compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and returns zero at once if the first string is empty. At the first mismatch it returns -1 when the second string's byte is smaller and 1 otherwise, which reverses the sign of the standard comparison.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:004E
name: compare_strings_for_equality_reversed
description: Library code that compares two zero-terminated strings and returns 0 when they are identical. At the first mismatch it returns -1 when the second string's byte is smaller and 1 otherwise, so the sign is reversed as in the standard comparison.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0062
name: find_first_byte_in_string
description: Library code that scans a zero-terminated string from its start for a given byte. It returns a pointer to the first match, or nothing if the terminator comes first.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:006C
name: scan_string_for_register_byte
description: Library code that walks forward through a zero-terminated string and compares each byte with a value held in a register. It returns a pointer to the first match, or nothing if the terminator is reached first.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:0074
name: find_match_after_first_byte
description: Library code that steps past the first byte of a zero-terminated string, then searches forward for a byte held in a register. It returns a pointer to the first match, or nothing if the terminator comes first.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:007E
name: find_last_byte_in_string
description: Library code that measures a zero-terminated string and then scans backward from its end for a given byte. It returns a pointer to the last match, or nothing if the byte is absent.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:009C
name: scan_backward_to_limit
description: Library code that compares the byte at a pointer with a value held in a register, then steps backward one byte at a time. It stops at the first match or when a lower limit held in another register is passed, and returns the match or nothing.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:00A4
name: find_previous_byte_above_limit
description: Library code that steps backward one byte before each comparison and stops once it passes a lower limit held in a register. It returns the position of the first byte equal to the value in another register, or nothing if none is found.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:00B2
name: skip_past_path_separator
description: Library code that looks for a slash in a string and, failing that, a colon. When either is found it returns the position just after it, and otherwise it returns the original pointer.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:9:00DA
name: increment_input_value
description: Library code that takes the value passed in the data register, adds one and returns the result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:1:0000
name: call_handler_and_return
description: Library wrapper that calls one other routine and returns immediately with no other work. A handler pointer stored in the first hunk's data reaches it.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:1:0012
name: call_stored_handler_and_return
description: Library wrapper that calls one other routine and returns with no other work. It is reached through a pointer in the first hunk's data, as the other wrappers at this point in the library are.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:1:001E
name: call_routine_and_return
description: Library wrapper that calls one other routine and returns with no other work. It is reached through a pointer in the first hunk's data.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:libs/diskfont.library:1:002C
name: call_routine_then_return
description: Library wrapper that calls one other routine and then returns, without any additional operations. It is reached through a pointer in the first hunk's data.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:SKID_ROW:0:0000
name: run_entry_and_close_library
description: Program entry code of the executable. It obtains the standard output handle and calls one routine, then calls a library function through a stored pointer when the preceding zero-flag test has not been set, and finally closes the exec library.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:SKID_ROW:0:0034
name: open_dos_library_base
description: Opens the dos library by calling exec's OldOpenLibrary through its library vector, then stores the returned library base in a global variable. The name dos.library is referenced by this same code.
